svg.title: Org-wide logging and detection architecture
svg.text: Every account emits signals → collection you can trust → correlation that tells a story → automated action
owns the org trail · no workloads
only the log pipeline can write
reads CloudTrail, VPC flow & DNS itself
+ S3 · EKS · Runtime · Malware · RDS · AI
normalizes to OCSF · Parquet in your S3
CloudTrail Lake's successor for new orgs
OCSF SQL over Security Lake or the trail
Rule of thumb: GuardDuty doesn't need your logs — but your hunters, auditors and lawyers do.
